sources.locator: §3.1 state recurrence and final coda; §3.3 Training Objective, Training Recurrent Models through Unrolling and Truncated Backpropagation
sources.inspection: 實讀原始 HTML 的 s_i=R(e,s_{i-1})、p=C(s_r) 與 E_x E_{r~Lambda} L(m_theta(x,r),x′)。同一 x′ 隨抽樣 r 監督；論文採 log-normal Poisson，教材 {1,3,5} 是自行簡化的離散例，沒有聲稱照搬論文配方。亦讀到只對最後 k=8 輪反傳的限制；額外 forward 輪數不能當作免費。
sources.excerpt: We optimize the expectation of the loss function L over random samples x from distribution X and random iteration counts r from distribution Λ.

sources.inspection: 實讀 companion local outputs 與從最後／中間輸出同時反傳的設計；式(3)用 alpha_m 加權輸出與 hidden losses，式(4)(5)都使用同一 y。原論文 CNN/SVM 主形式有 hinge threshold，另允許 Softmax，並非教材精確的共享迴圈 CE 平均公式；它支持 deep supervision 的基本結構與用途。§2.1明言中間層目標可能干擾整體表現的關切，不將其實驗結果外推成本課保證。
sources.excerpt: Backpropagation of error now proceeds as usual, with the crucial difference that we now backpropagate not only from the final layer but also simultaneously from our local companion output.
